target_customer: Developers, quants, traders, students and fintech builders who need stock, forex and crypto data through APIs and spreadsheets, with a free tier and paid plans
problem: Market data from legacy providers was expensive or hard to get, and demand jumped when Yahoo Finance discontinued its free data APIs in 2017.
business_model: Freemium usage-based market data API with paid premium plans

founders.name: Olivier Porte
prior_employers: Financial services firms in New York and Tokyo, including work with legacy financial data providers
founders.background_notes: Harbus profile, May 2018. YC page says he was born in London, raised in Tokyo and the Bay Area, and angel invests.

founders.name: Steve Zheng
education: Computer science at an unnamed institute along the Charles River

competitors.name: Yahoo Finance free API
competitors.what: Free web-based financial data APIs that developers used before Yahoo discontinued them in May 2017
competitors.traction_then: Widely used by developers until discontinued; users then sought alternatives

competitors.name: Legacy financial data providers
competitors.what: Incumbent Wall Street data vendors with expensive or hard-to-access data, unnamed in the source

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and serving market data through REST endpoints is standard engineering; the hard parts were data licensing and reliability at scale.

defensibility.rationale: Data is largely licensed, so copying is easy by other API vendors; later Nasdaq licensing gave some position, claimed on the company site.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; a third-party overview says it remains independently run by its founders.

market_need_then: Yahoo Finance discontinued its free data APIs in May 2017 and the founders reported demand grew afterward; Zheng personally struggled to find affordable reliable data (Harbus, May 2018).

branding.domain_note: Uses alphavantage.co rather than a .com; history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission statement of democratizing access to premium financial data

branding.brand_signature: A free API key and the Alpha Academy knowledge base
branding.community_and_virality: Developers on Stack Overflow moved code to Alpha Vantage after Yahoo ended its API, and a 2024 trade story describes developers turning to it after IEX Cloud shut down; no merch evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Became a common default free stock API name among developers per Stack Overflow and later press, though the name is generic finance wording and no mascot or community assets were found.

outcome_analysis: Alpha Vantage grew from a graduate school side project into a widely used free market data API after Yahoo ended its free APIs. It joined YC in summer 2018 and later became a Nasdaq licensed provider per its own site. It remains active with no sourced acquisition, layoffs or legal trouble, and later benefited when IEX Cloud closed in 2024. Venture funding details are not reliably public.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights shows about 1.39 million across four rounds with a 1.27 million seed in September 2018, Startup Intros shows 2 million in August 2018 with an implausibly long investor list, and Seedtable shows 2.2 million. All are aggregators that conflict, so no round is recorded. Harbus article says it launched in March 2017 and Yahoo discontinued its API in May 2017. Nasdaq licensing claim is from the company site only. IEX Cloud launched in 2019 so it is not a competitor as of founding. Completeness pass: one 2018 seed is recorded without an amount because aggregators conflict (Seedtable 2.2M, Startup Intros 2M dated 2018-08, CB Insights 1.27M dated 2018-09 with Flybridge Capital Partners, 1.39M total over four rounds). No press source found.
